Rank 2 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 20 Ki
  • Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
  • Range: 60 feet
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: No

You take a moment to inspect a target, looking for any weak points. Choose 1 target in range, the next Weapon Attack you make against that target using Simple or Martial Weapons ignores their Proficiency Bonus and Power Bonus to AC.

This Technique is ended if you use it again before attacking the target.
